name: l3/pipeline/ALL_all_scenarios
description: All scenarios together: removal -> events -> links -> sync_time against the synthetic fixture with the pre-run graph from graph_seed.json. All seven scenarios in one run, to show they do not interfere
comparison: canonical: `writes` is ordered and compared element by element. Each write's `set` and `del` are its N-Quad lines after canonicalisation (parity/README.md §Canonical form): split on newline, blank lines dropped, `<0x..>` rewritten to `<uid:UNIQUE_ID>`, blank nodes rewritten to `_:new:UNIQUE_ID`, sorted bytewise. Line text is otherwise byte-exact, including literal escaping and facet order. Blank-node label strings are NOT compared (P4-3); one label per unique_id per mutation IS required. `graph_after` and `sync_time_stamped` are compared exactly. `lookups_informational` documents reads and is not part of the contract.
